name: com.snap.shopping.camerakit.tryon.ImageTryOnApplyTryOnActivity
description: After a shopper selects a full-body photo, this screen lets them review or change it, then starts Snap Camera Kit's 2D try-on that generates an image of the selected product on them.
disableEffect: Shoppers will not be able to confirm their photo and generate a 2D try-on result.
